definition: Each Han is exactly two sound keys. Sum every native interval once using L4i2 centrally and native boundary roles at Han-run ends. Punctuation/line ends split runs. No word resets, error losses, or startup penalty.

timingModel.interpretation: Experimental timing-only reconstruction: frozen native equivalent minus rebuilt pinned XGB error probability times recovery time. Continuous use is a local-context extrapolation, not a measured long-string model.

scoreDefinition: 100 * f19 msPerHan / candidate msPerHan; higher is better; primary physical quantity is msPerHan
